content: This medication is specifically effective for treating vaginal fungal infections. It should not be used if you experience symptoms such as fever, chills, flu-like symptoms, abdominal or stomach pain, or foul-smelling vaginal discharge. Instructions for Use: If you are using an over-the-counter product for self-treatment, carefully read all the instructions provided on the product packaging before use. If you have any questions, consult your pharmacist. This medication is intended for vaginal use only. Wash your hands thoroughly before and after application. Avoid contact with your eyes. If the ointment accidentally gets into your eyes, rinse them immediately with plenty of water. Typically, this medication is administered as a single dose at bedtime or as directed by your physician. Follow all preparation and usage instructions provided in the product packaging. To apply, lie on your back with your knees bent toward your chest. Insert the applicator filled with the medication into the vagina as far as it comfortably goes. Slowly press the plunger of the applicator to release the full dose of the ointment. While using this medication, do not use tampons, douches, spermicides, or other vaginal products. Notify your doctor if your condition does not improve after three days or if symptoms persist for more than seven days. Additionally, inform your doctor if the infection recurs within two months. Side Effects: Common side effects may include headaches or vaginal/urethral burning, itching, or pain. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar concerns. Precautions: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other azole antifungal agents (e.g., clotrimazole, fluconazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. Ask your doctor whether it is safe to engage in sexual intercourse while using this product. This medication may weaken rubber products such as latex condoms, diaphragms, or cervical caps, potentially leading to failure and resulting in pregnancy. Avoid using these products during treatment and for three days after completing treatment. Do not use this medication for self-treatment if you are pregnant. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. If you are pregnant, follow your doctor’s instructions on how to use the applicator to insert the medication. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: This medication may be harmful if swallowed. If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Notes: To help prevent vaginal yeast infections, thoroughly dry the genital area after showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for extended periods. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
